name: mnemic_coalescence_hunter_ai
label: Memory Coalescence Hunter
poeticVision: The chilling dread of seeing your own lost memories physically manifest as new, terrifying abilities in your hunter. It's not just a chase for survival, but a desperate race to prevent pieces of your past from being weaponized against you. You will feel the profound violation of your identity not just dissolving, but being absorbed and twisted by the very entities hunting you, making each encounter a fight against a warped reflection of yourself.

parameters.name: move_speed
parameters.description: Movement speed of the hunter when pursuing a memory fragment.

parameters.name: assimilation_range
parameters.description: The distance at which the hunter will assimilate a detected memory fragment.

dependencies: Area3D (child of hunter, named 'DetectionArea', for memory detection)
MeshInstance3D (child of hunter, named 'MeshInstance3D', for visual representation)
ShaderMaterial (applied to 'MeshInstance3D', using the provided GLSL shader code)
memory_fragment_resource.gd (custom Resource script, defined in usage)
memory_fragment_node.gd (Node3D script for physical memory fragments, defined in usage)
verdict: A chilling reflection of self-loss, this hunter transforms forgotten fragments into a weaponized past, making every pursuit a battle against a piece of your own dissolving soul.
impact: The player will experience a profound sense of dread and violation. Every memory fragment they fail to protect will not just be lost, but actively turned against them, making the hunters more formidable and personally threatening. This escalates the emotional stakes of each encounter, transforming a simple chase into a fight against a twisted reflection of their own past, deepening the game's core theme of self-loss.
